result.topic_en: Calculations with bracket symbols (determinant-like minors indexed by pairs of the indices 1–5) expressed through quantities α, β, γ and t, leading to invariant-like expressions K_1, K_2 in terms of a, b, c, d; at the bottom, written upside down, some formulas involving partial derivatives and a sum of squares.
result.transcription:
$t = \begin{smallmatrix}31\\32\\34\end{smallmatrix}$ $\begin{smallmatrix}13\\23\\45\end{smallmatrix} = \alpha+\gamma$ $\begin{smallmatrix}12\\34\\35\end{smallmatrix} = \alpha-\gamma$ $\begin{smallmatrix}13\\24\\35\end{smallmatrix} = \alpha+\beta$ $\begin{smallmatrix}15\\23\\34\end{smallmatrix} = \beta-\alpha$ $\begin{smallmatrix}14\\23\\35\end{smallmatrix} = \beta+\gamma$ $\begin{smallmatrix}13\\25\\34\end{smallmatrix} = \beta-\gamma$, $\begin{smallmatrix}12\\45\end{smallmatrix} = \frac{\alpha^2-\beta^2}{t}$ $\begin{smallmatrix}15\\24\end{smallmatrix} = \frac{\beta^2-\gamma^2}{t}$ $\begin{smallmatrix}41\\25\end{smallmatrix} = \frac{\gamma^2-\beta^2}{t}$
$\begin{smallmatrix}14\\15\\23\\25\\45\end{smallmatrix} = \frac{(\beta-\alpha)(\beta+\gamma)(\alpha+\gamma)}{t}$ $\begin{smallmatrix}12\\13\\24\\25\\45\end{smallmatrix} = \frac{(\alpha+\beta)(\alpha+\gamma)(\beta-\gamma)}{t}$ $\begin{smallmatrix}12\\15\\24\\34\end{smallmatrix} = \frac{(\alpha-\gamma)(\beta-\alpha)(\beta-\gamma)}{t}$, $\begin{smallmatrix}12\\14\\24\\35\end{smallmatrix} = \frac{(\alpha-\gamma)(\alpha+\beta)(\beta+\gamma)}{t}$
$\alpha^2+\beta^2+\gamma^2 = a$, $\alpha\beta\gamma = b$, $2(\alpha^4+\beta^4+\gamma^4-\alpha^2\beta^2-\alpha^2\gamma^2-\beta^2\gamma^2) = t^2\left(\begin{smallmatrix}12\\45\end{smallmatrix}^2+\begin{smallmatrix}15\\24\end{smallmatrix}^2+\begin{smallmatrix}14\\25\end{smallmatrix}^2\right) = t^2 c$, $t^3\left(\begin{smallmatrix}12\\45\end{smallmatrix}-\begin{smallmatrix}15\\24\end{smallmatrix}\right)\left(\begin{smallmatrix}15\\24\end{smallmatrix}-\begin{smallmatrix}41\\25\end{smallmatrix}\right)\left(\begin{smallmatrix}41\\25\end{smallmatrix}-\begin{smallmatrix}12\\45\end{smallmatrix}\right) = [-\frac{1}{3}a^3+\frac{1}{6}t^2ac-] = t^3 d = 27b^2-a^3+\frac{3}{2}act^2$
$K_1 = \sum\left(\begin{smallmatrix}14\\15\\23\\24\\45\end{smallmatrix}^2 + \begin{smallmatrix}14\\23\\24\\35\end{smallmatrix}^2\right) = \frac{4}{3}(ac-\frac{1}{4}td)$ [?]
$K_2 = \begin{smallmatrix}12\\13\\14\\15\\23\end{smallmatrix}^2 \begin{smallmatrix}24\\25\\34\\35\\41\end{smallmatrix}^2 = \frac{1}{27}(\frac{1}{2}c^3t^2-d^2t^2)$ [?]

[upside down at bottom of page:]
$\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = 0$ $u = z\frac{\partial x}{\partial y} - z\frac{\partial x}{\partial z}$ [?] $v = z\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - z\frac{\partial y}{\partial z}$ [?]
$\lambda_1+\lambda_2+\lambda_3 = \frac{\partial x}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial y}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial z}$, $\lambda_1^2+\lambda_2^2+\lambda_3^2 = \dots$ [?]
$\dots = \frac{1}{2}\left[\dots\right]$ [?]

methods.what: Parametrization of 3x3 bracket minors of five points by quantities α, β, γ and t
Definition of symmetric functions a, b, c of α, β, γ
Discriminant-like product of differences expressed via a, b, c
Invariants K_1, K_2 as sums/products of squared brackets expressed via a, c, d, t
